name: How can I prepare my home for a major remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my home for a major remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparing your home involves several steps. First, declutter and remove all personal items from the work areas. Protect furniture and floors in adjacent rooms by covering them. Arrange for temporary living solutions if the project makes your home uninhabitable. Discuss access points with your contractor to minimize disruption to your daily routine. Ensure utilities are accessible and clearly communicate any special instructions or concerns regarding pets or children. Being prepared helps the project run smoothly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by decluttering work areas, protecting nearby furniture, arranging temporary living if needed, and discussing access with your contractor. Communicate special instructions.
